eligibility_clarification: User explicitly keeps P14 tumor populations activated/expanded in vitro before transfer; drug-treated and gene-perturbed cells remain excluded.
RDS_policy: Local R script is unverified provenance; it writes different _paper_WNN.rds filenames, does not establish provenance for the inventoried postQC RDS objects, and references an externally defined blacklist_mm10. Do not execute it or use its labels as a whitelist.
other_findings: Remaining 17 libraries predominantly express T/CD8 markers; NK-associated Nkg7/Klrd1 expression is not by itself an NK exclusion.
KPCGP Foxp3-associated cells are not blanket-removed.
Trdc detection alone is not a gamma/delta identity call.
No whole low-RNA CD8 cluster is removed merely for lower depth.
Existing W8/W9 Step09 exports are preserved; new scores are diagnostic comparisons only.
Gut/tumor retain original Step04 candidate flags; broader populations are modeled only for comparison.
